description.value:
Not every berserker believes offense alone wins battles. The Juggernaut Approach holds that the best defense is an unmovable one: its followers strap on the heaviest armor they can find, not out of caution, but because a wall of durasteel bearing down on you is its own kind of terror.

These berserkers turn bulk into momentum, using their armored mass to shove, shield, and flatten anyone foolish enough to stand between them and their target.
